data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1969 experienced a gross strengthening of $18.252 million in prior year claims reserves for 2023, representing a 2.23% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was attributed to adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years across several lines of business including Aviation, Property Binder, Marine Hull, Offshore Energy, Non-Marine Liability, Specialty Disruption, and Warranties & Indemnities. The report also noted a strengthening of reserving for prior year development of 4% (net) for the 2023 calendar year. Specific events from prior years, such as Hurricane Ian (2022) and the ongoing Russia/Ukraine conflict (2021), continued to impact the 2022 year of account, while Cyclone Gabrielle (2023) also affected the 2022 year of account.
